title: RIGBY: Low-Cost Mobile Bimanual Manipulator
description: Developed an accessible assistive robot for household tasks, combining a mobile base, asymmetric bimanual arms, imitation learning from demonstration, and a web/touch/voice interface for non-expert users.

title: Smart Robot Assistant
description: Built a friendly interactive robotic companion capable of autonomously aiding children with disabilities with activities of daily living and adaptive game-playing support.

title: Adaptive Chess Coach Robotic Arm
description: Built and programmed a robotic chess coach that replicates virtual chess moves into a real chess game, provides real-time assistance, and adjusts gameplay difficulty according to user needs.

title: FPGA Mandelbrot Set Accelerator
description: Designed and implemented an FPGA hardware accelerator for Mandelbrot set computation, enabling real-time exploration with a 600x speed-up over a regular CPU implementation.

title: Search Fund Database
description: Built a database filter to isolate search results using 12 search criteria from more than 800,000 items.

title: Prompt-Aware Web Scraper
description: Built an automated NLP tool that uses text embeddings to identify and scrape relevant Google search results based on user prompts.

title: Market Making Algorithm
description: Developed an algorithmic trading model that ranked 3rd in the Optiver trading competition at Imperial College London against 100 participants.
